defendant.background: From the slums, father was absent, mother died when young

prosecution.name: The Switchblade
prosecution.description: A unique switchblade found at the crime scene

details.defendant_claim: Lost his similar knife on night of murder

prosecution.name: The Woman Across the Street
prosecution.description: Claims she saw the murder through windows of passing el train

details.location: Apartment across the street, 60 feet away
details.marks: Wore glasses, saw defendant stab father

prosecution.name: The Old Man Downstairs
prosecution.description: Heard argument and body fall, saw defendant running

details.heard: "I'm going to kill you!" then body falling
details.saw: Defendant running down stairs 15 seconds later
details.time_to_door: Witness claimed 15 seconds from bedroom to door

prosecution.name: The Defendant's Alibi
prosecution.description: Claimed to be at movies but couldn't name film

details.claim: Was at movies from 11:30 PM to 3:10 AM
details.problem: Could not name the films or recall details

defense.name: Similar Knife Available
defense.description: Exact same knife pattern found in pawn shop

details.location: Pawn shop 2 blocks from defendant's home

details.distance: Bedroom to front door is 43 feet
details.walk_time: Would take at least 30 seconds with cane
details.train_passing: Train makes loud noise, couldn't hear clearly

defense.name: Woman's Vision
defense.description: Woman wore glasses, wasn't wearing them in bed

details.time: 12:10 AM - most people don't wear glasses to sleep

drama_beats.description: Discussion of old man's timeline and credibility
